title: Phase 3A.1 Normalized Source Verification Record
description: Normalized schema for source verification records with strict semantics

sourcePackSourceId.description: Source ID from the frozen discovery corpus

verificationSourceId.description: Source ID in the verification ledger (may match sourcePackSourceId)

titleMatch.description: Whether observed title matches discovery title (exact or normalized)

titleMismatchReason.description: Explanation when titleMatch=false. Required if titleMatch=false and verificationStatus=VERIFIED

publicationDateObserved.description: Publication date from the source itself, NOT HTTP/retrieval timestamps

publicationDateEvidence.description: How the publication date was determined

versionDateObserved.description: Version date if different from publication date

pageLastModified.description: HTTP Last-Modified header or page metadata timestamp (NOT publication date)

sourceExists.description: Whether the source URL is accessible/exists (even if content not retrieved)

sourceIdentityVerified.description: Whether source identity (title, publisher, author) was verified against the discovery record

VERIFIED_requires: if titleMatch=false then titleMismatchReason must be non-empty
BLOCKED_requires: sourceExists or sourceIdentityVerified should be true (source exists but content inaccessible)
notes must explain the blocking reason
FAILED_requires: notes must explain why source is considered failed (not tool error)
validationRules.publicationDate_rule: publicationDateObserved must NOT equal pageLastModified or retrievedAt without publicationDateEvidence
